sleeping_bag.name: PANYAM 450
sleeping_bag.subtitle: ultralight 3-season down sleeping bag
sleeping_bag.description: Panyam 450 is presented as the most versatile sleeping bag in the range, intended for autumn trekking tours and quick spring excursions in the mountains. The Panyam structure uses trapezoid chambers, an independent 3D collar, a slightly wider cut, shark-fin footbox and 3D hood.
sleeping_bag.key_features:
- 810 g total weight
- 450 g of 850 FP ethically sourced Polish goose down
- Comfort 0 C / limit -6 C / extreme -23 C
- Trapezoid chambers
- Independent 3D collar
- Full-length 5 mm YKK zip with 2 self-locking sliders
- Anti-snag system and zipper garage
- 3D hood
- Anatomical shark-fin footbox
- Inner pocket with noctilucent puller
sleeping_bag.manufacturer_claims: Cumulus presents Panyam 450 as its most versatile model: not too warm in summer, but highly suitable once the first frosty autumn days arrive.
sleeping_bag.ideal_for: Autumn trekking tours, quick spring mountain excursions, broad 3-season use.
sleeping_bag.comparison_notes: User-provided France capture shows 409 EUR. Indexed official Cumulus pages crawled earlier showed lower values such as 375 EUR.
sleeping_bag.warranty_notes: Lifetime Experience warranty shown on official pages.
